title: 4 PIECES OF FIGGIO DESIGN CHIN...
reason: Figgjo Turi 'Market' pattern coffee pot with milk jug, cream jug and sugar bowl, a collected Scandinavian retro design; my estimate about $100 to $150 for the four despite the small chips.
findings: Single photo of four pieces in one pattern: a lidded coffee pot, a taller milk jug, a small cream jug and a straight-sided sugar bowl with no handles or lid. White speckled stoneware with olive green, dark green and grey folk figures at a market stall with fruit and flowers. The pattern looks like Figgjo Flint (Norway) 'Market' from the Turi-Design range by Turi Gramstad Oliver, which fits the title's 'Figgio' (sic, Figgjo). No backstamp is visible (one photo, bases not shown), so the maker is judged from the pattern, not from a read mark. The count matches the title (4 pieces).
condition: Small brown glaze chips: one on the sugar bowl rim at upper left, one at the foot of the milk jug, a chip and flaking near the top of the coffee pot handle join with some staining beside the handle, and a dark spot at the spout tip (possible chip). Light speckling and crazing in the glaze. The lid fits and the knob looks intact.
rescore_note: Pattern matches Figgjo Flint 'Market' by Turi Gramstad Oliver (made 1966 to 1980 and exported to Australia in large numbers, so common here: https://c20ceramics.net/2017/05/23/figgjo-norway-market-design/), with the maker judged from the pattern only as no backstamp is visible; the sugar bowl has no lid and all four pieces are chipped, so realistic value is about AU$50 to $90 for the set (no dated sold comparables found, only dealer asking prices).
